components.name: Logo
components.description: Squared-C trail mark with two-tone 'Clear Cause' wordmark, on forest-deep.
components.html: Clear Cause
components.css: .ds-logo { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 14px 18px; background: oklch(0.3 0.064 158); text-decoration: none; } .ds-logo svg { transition: transform 300ms ease-out; } .ds-logo:hover svg { transform: rotate(-3deg); } .ds-logo span { font-family: 'Libre Franklin Variable', sans-serif; font-size: 1.3125rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.03em; line-height: 1; color: oklch(0.972 0.013 84); } .ds-logo em { font-style: normal; color: oklch(0.915 0.035 150); } .ds-logo:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.972 0.013 84); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Cause Tile
components.description: Photo over a label strip; picked tiles get a paper outline and paper label with a check.
components.css: .ds-tiles { display: flex; gap: 8px; padding: 16px; background: oklch(0.3 0.064 158); } .ds-tile { width: 150px; border-radius: 2px; overflow: hidden; background: oklch(0.375 0.078 157); font-family: 'Libre Franklin Variable', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-tile i { display: block; aspect-ratio: 7 / 5; background: oklch(0.55 0.04 140); opacity: 0.6; } .ds-tile span { display: block; padding: 8px 10px; color: oklch(0.972 0.013 84); } .ds-tile.on { outline: 3px solid oklch(0.972 0.013 84); } .ds-tile.on i { opacity: 1; } .ds-tile.on span { background: oklch(0.972 0.013 84); color: oklch(0.3 0.064 158); }

components.name: Primary Button

components.name: Amount Choice

components.css: .ds-choices { display: flex; gap: 6px; } .ds-choice { height: 40px; min-width: 64px; background: var(--paper, oklch(0.972 0.013 84)); color: var(--ink, oklch(0.255 0.055 258)); border: 1px solid oklch(0.72 0.025 84); border-radius: 2px; font-family: 'Libre Franklin Variable', sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms ease, background 150ms ease; } .ds-choice:hover { border-color: var(--forest, oklch(0.375 0.078 157)); } .ds-choice[aria-pressed=true] { background: var(--forest, oklch(0.375 0.078 157)); border-color: var(--forest, oklch(0.375 0.078 157)); color: var(--paper, oklch(0.972 0.013 84)); } .ds-choice:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--forest, oklch(0.375 0.078 157)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Amount Field

components.name: Statement Table
components.description: Ruled label/figure rows closed by a double-ruled total; program money highlighted.
components.css: .ds-stmt { width: 100%; max-width: 360px; border-collapse: collapse; font-family: 'Libre Franklin Variable', sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: oklch(0.255 0.055 258); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums; } .ds-stmt caption { text-align: left; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.125rem; padding-bottom: 8px; } .ds-stmt th { text-align: left; font-weight: 400; padding: 8px 12px 8px 0; } .ds-stmt td { text-align: right; padding: 8px 0; } .ds-stmt tr:not(.ds-total) { border-bottom: 1px solid oklch(0.85 0.02 84); } .ds-stmt mark { background: oklch(0.83 0.165 146); color: inherit; font-weight: 600; padding: 0 2px; } .ds-total th, .ds-total td { font-weight: 600; padding-top: 10px; } .ds-total td span { border-bottom: 3px double oklch(0.255 0.055 258); padding-bottom: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Clear Cause reads like a well-made annual report or a good bank statement, not a startup landing page. Every surface is a document with a forest-green frame around it. Inside, ink-navy figures sit on warm paper in ruled rows, with totals double-underlined the way accountants close a column. Numbers are the hero. Prose explains them, and decoration never stands in for them.

The world owns the frame: the forest masthead and colophon, the forest rule that opens each section, and the ruled tables. The reading column stays calm: a book serif at a real measure, high contrast, and nothing moving behind it. Color is restrained (paper, ink, forest), with one exception that carries meaning: a bright green highlighter marks money that reached programs, and is used for nothing else.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper ground, ink-navy type and figures, and forest green as the structural color.
Hairline-ruled tables with right-aligned tabular figures and double-ruled totals.
One bright green, used only as a highlighter behind money that reached programs.
A grotesk for statements and figures, and a book serif for prose.
Square corners, flat print, no shadows.

rules.name: The Band Tone Rule
rules.body: A band never introduces a new hue. Forest-deep, ink and forest-soft are the only band grounds, and money green is never a ground.

rules.name: The One Highlighter Rule
rules.body: The bright green marks only money that reached programs. Never use it for navigation, selection, success states, badges, or decoration. Ask of every bright-green pixel: did money go here?

rules.name: The Focal Figure Rule
rules.body: A highlighter loses its meaning when everything is highlighted. Mark totals and program lines, not every row in a ledger.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every number that could sit in a column uses tabular lining figures (`.figures`), so columns align and amounts can be compared at a glance.

rules.name: The Sentence Lead Rule
rules.body: The key number is set inside a sentence ("Of every $1.00… 84¢ went to programs"), never as a giant isolated figure above a small label.

rules.name: The Flat Print Rule
rules.body: If it would not survive being printed on uncoated stock, it does not belong: no shadows, glows, blur, or glass.

dos: Do set every figure in tabular lining figures and right-align it in its column.
Do open each section with the 2px forest rule and a plain heading. Let the heading speak without a label above it.
Do close every column of money with a double-ruled total.
Do keep audited facts and self-reported counts visibly separate, solid against dashed, everywhere they appear.
Do label sample or illustrative data plainly, above the fold.
Do theme the browser surfaces: money-green text selection, forest focus rings and caret, paper-toned scrollbars.
Do carry color at page scale on marketing pages with forest, ink and soft bands, alternating with paper.
Do caption every stock photo, and say "not the organization" beside a named org.
donts: Don't use the money green for anything except money that reached programs: not nav states, success, badges, or selection controls.
Don't use purple, gradients, glassmorphism, or glowing shadows.
Don't use emoji as icons. Icons come from Lucide at a consistent 1.75–2.5 stroke.
Don't build a centered hero with a big headline and two buttons, or rows of three identical rounded cards.
Don't set Inter as the only font, or round everything to 2xl. Corners stay at 2px.
Don't put a big isolated number over a small label. Put the figure inside a sentence or a table.
